title: The completion of a Noetherian local ring is local with the same residue field
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring and $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR/\mathfrak m^n$ its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with canonical map $\iota:R\to R^\wedge$ and $\pi:R^\wedge\to R/\mathfrak m$, $(x_n)_n\mapsto x_1$. Then $R^\wedge$ is a local ring whose maximal ideal is $\mathfrak mR^\wedge$ (the ideal generated by $\iota(\mathfrak m)$), which equals $\ker\pi$; an element $x\in R^\wedge$ is a unit if and only if $\pi(x)\neq0$; and $\iota$ induces an isomorphism of residue fields $R/\mathfrak m\xrightarrow{\sim}R^\wedge/\mathfrak mR^\wedge$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05GI (lemma-radical-completion, line 22734), part (1) with I = m (an element mapping to a unit of R/m is a unit), together with Lemma Tag 05GG (lemma-hathat-finitely-generated, line 22645: ker(R^ -> R/m) = mR^ and R^/mR^ = R/m for m finitely generated)
